_doc: Master Notice-of-Default (NoD) and lender-foreclosure file for master developers / top property owners of CA land-secured CFDs. Indexed by developer entity.
_methodology: Free-tier sweep of California county recorder portals (Stanislaus RecorderWorks, Placer, others), PropertyShark/PropertyRadar surface tier, news archives (SierraSun, ttownmedia, LABusinessJournal, sjvsun, ElevenFlo), CDIAC default-draw narratives, and SEC filings for public-co master developers (FivePoint Holdings FPH, Lennar LEN, KB Home KBH, Pulte PHM). Conducted 2026-05-28, time-boxed ~75 minutes. NoDs found in news/legal records cite source URLs; recording_id is set to UNVERIFIABLE_NEWS_REFERENCED where the news source identifies the NoD but the exact recorder document number was not retrieved (recorder portals require interactive name search not feasible via WebFetch).

_data_quality_legend.HIGH: NoD confirmed by primary lender public statement OR multiple independent news sources OR direct recorder citation
_data_quality_legend.MEDIUM: NoD reported by single credible news source but exact recording number not pulled
_data_quality_legend.LOW: NoD inferred from bankruptcy filings or developer financial distress without direct lender NoD recording cited

_paywall_notes.PropertyShark_Stanislaus: 680 pre-foreclosures last 2.5yr documented but borrower names locked behind Elite subscription (~$99/mo). Surface tier shows only recent residential NoDs, not historical developer-LLC NoDs.
_paywall_notes.PropertyRadar: 5-day free trial requires credit card. Not used in this build.
_paywall_notes.Stanislaus_RecorderWorks: Free, supports grantor-name + document-type (NTCE DEFAULT) filter. Indexed 1/1/1850-current. NOT exercised interactively in this build — would require workflow-based scraping outside time-box.
_paywall_notes.Imperial_Recorder: Limited online presence; tax-collector delinquent list is the primary free product.
_paywall_notes.Riverside_Assessor_Clerk_Recorder: Free online grantor search; not exercised in this build.

_calibration.expected_universe_fire_rate_HIGH_MEDIUM: 5-10% of housing CFDs in 24-month lookback; LOWER outside cycle-peak vintage CFDs

East West Partners (Northstar / Truckee)._relationship_to_cfd: Predecessor master developer of Northstar Highlands, Old Greenwood, Gray's Crossing properties — same parcels later acquired by Mountainside Partners then Mountainside Builders / Taylor Builders. Connected to northstar_csd_1 CFD via the parcel chain of title.

Tahoe Boca LLC (Canyon Springs)._relationship_to_cfd: Canyon Springs is in the Glenshire area east of Truckee; falls within the same Nevada/Placer County land-secured development micro-cluster as Northstar CFD parcels though not directly inside northstar_csd_1 CFD boundary. Useful as control/comparable.

LandSource Communities Development LLC (._current_successor_status_2026: FivePoint Holdings (NYSE: FPH) is publicly traded, solvent, top taxpayer at irvine_2013_3 CFD which shows 0.1% delinquency on $904M par — no current developer distress. The 2008 NoD is HISTORICAL and outside the 24-month detector window. Per detector logic this would NOT fire on a 2026-05-28 snapshot.

Diablo Grande original developers (Donal._relationship_to_cfd: Original master developer of Western Hills Water District Diablo Grande CFD No 1 (diablo_grande_1). Filed Ch 11 March 10, 2008. Project sold to World International LLC October 2008 for $20M (vs ~$120M originally invested). No specific construction-loan NoD by name retrieved in this sweep.

World International LLC (Diablo Grande 2._relationship_to_cfd: Acquired Diablo Grande for $20M Oct 2008. Stopped paying special taxes end of 2017. Cumulative arrears ~$6M by 2020.

additional_distress_events.event: Special-tax default and CFD judicial foreclosure (NOT a lender NoD)
additional_distress_events.outcome: Sold Diablo Grande properties to Angels Crossing LLC 2020-05-07
additional_distress_events.court_case: CV-24-003049 Western Hills Water District vs World International LLC (Stanislaus Superior Court)
additional_distress_events._note: This is issuer-initiated judicial foreclosure on special-tax delinquency under Govt Code 53356.1 — NOT a private lender NoD under CC 2924. Distinct legal mechanism; recorded as additional_distress not nod_events.

Angels Crossing LLC (Diablo Grande 2020-._relationship_to_cfd: Successor owner from May 2020. Failed to pay $12.6M in taxes on 13 parcels + $668,910 on 63 other properties. Western Hills Water District obtained judicial foreclosure judgment Jan 19, 2023; properties auctioned Aug 3, 2023 in Modesto via sheriff's credit-bid sale.

additional_distress_events.event: CFD judicial foreclosure (Govt Code 53356.1) and sheriff's auction
additional_distress_events.outcome: Western Hills Water District credit-bid took title; 75+ mostly undeveloped properties seized; led to Ch 9 filing 2025-11-25

PCC La Jolla Palms LLC / PCG La Jolla Pa._relationship_to_cfd: Master developer of City of Calexico Community Facilities District No. 2005-1 (Hearthstone), 248-home master plan in Imperial County. Developer filed bankruptcy and 'left the property'; city foreclosed. Project remains incomplete; $40M construction cost estimate vs $14.7M original CFD set-aside; $3.25M still owed to local school district.

additional_distress_events.event: Developer bankruptcy + city foreclosure on master plan parcels
additional_distress_events.date_approx: Pre-2024 (article describes situation as 20+ years of conversation; specific filing date not pulled)
additional_distress_events.lender_referenced: U.S. Bank serves as escrow holder for bond holders
additional_distress_events.city_action: City foreclosed on property and seeking new developer

Mountainside Builders LLC / Taylor Build._relationship_to_cfd: Acquired 945-acre Northstar-area land portfolio in Aug 2018 from Mountainside Partners (East West Partners successor). Top taxpayer in northstar_csd_1 CFD. Multiple special-tax delinquencies 2018-2024 led to CFD judicial foreclosure complaints (Placer Superior Court Cases S-CV-0042801 and S-CV-0043081). No private lender NoD against Mountainside Builders' construction financing surfaced in this sweep.

additional_distress_events.event: CFD judicial foreclosure on developer parcels (Govt Code 53356.1)
additional_distress_events.outcome: Judgment 2020-08-12; writs of sale obtained; some sheriff sales 2022+

Mast Capital._misidentification_note: User prompt listed 'Mast Capital / Diablo Grande / Western Hills Water District'. Verification: Mast Capital is a Miami-based developer (Coconut Grove FL) actively closing 2024-25 construction loans for Florida luxury condos including the $600M Cipriani Residences Miami and $390M Miami Beach project. NO documented California or Diablo Grande connection found in 2024-25 news. The Diablo Grande developer chain is in fact: original Panoz developers (Ch 11 2008) -> World International (2008-2020) -> Angels Crossing (2020-2023, lost in foreclosure) -> Western Hills Water District (via CFD credit bid 2023). Mast Capital does NOT appear in this chain based on public sources sweep.
Mast Capital._action: Recording the misidentification rather than fabricating data. If 'Mast Capital' was a placeholder for a different California developer, the per-obligor JSON for diablo_grande_1 has been updated with the actual Panoz/World International/Angels Crossing chain.

FivePoint Holdings (NYSE: FPH)._relationship_to_cfd: Top taxpayer at irvine_2013_3 CFD (Great Park Neighborhoods); also active in unbuilt Newhall Ranch / Valencia phases. PUBLIC company; would disclose any material loan default via 8-K. No NoD or material default disclosed 2024-26.
FivePoint Holdings (NYSE: FPH)._solvency_check_2026: Solvent; publicly traded; irvine_2013_3 CFD shows 0.1% delinquency on $904M par at RY 2023-24 — no current developer distress

Cambay Group (River Islands at Lathrop)._relationship_to_cfd: Master developer of River Islands at Lathrop CFD (river_islands_2003_1). Per Manteca Bulletin: selling ~500 homes/year, named Best-Selling Master Planned Community in Northern California. No NoD or distress event surfaced in 2008-2026 sweep.
Cambay Group (River Islands at Lathrop)._lake_elsinore_2007_5_connection: User prompt suggested Cambay Group / Lake Elsinore CFD 2007-5 linkage. Could NOT verify this in public sources. Cambay's documented California footprint is River Islands (Lathrop), Windemere (San Ramon), and the East Bay. Lake Elsinore CFD 2007-5 master developer NOT identified in this sweep.
Cambay Group (River Islands at Lathrop)._solvency_check_2026: Active and selling; no documented distress

The New Home Company (NWHM)._relationship_to_cfd: Inland Empire / Northern California homebuilder; potential top taxpayer at multiple housing CFDs. Per SEC 10-Q filings (FY2020) had $7M PPP loan and standard A&D / construction revolvers. No NoD found in public news 2018-2026.
The New Home Company (NWHM)._solvency_check_2026: No public distress reported. SEC filings show normal operations through 2020 then taken private.
